book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Yeesu arabharagania abhaanabheega bhaaye ikumi na bhabhiri
Yeesu akabhabhirikira abhaanabheega bhaaye ikumi na bhabhiri, akabhaha obhunagya bhwo okuheebha amasaambwa amabhi okurwa kubhaatu no okuhorya amarweeri.
Amariina ga abheega ikumi na bhabhiri bhayo nigo gano: Wo okutaanga ni Simooni wuno Yeesu akamutoga Petero, na Andurea wamwaabhu, Yaakobo omwaana wa Zebedaayo na Yohana wamwaabhu,
Firipo, Baritoromaayo, Tomaso, Mataayo wuno yaari omutobhya we eriigooti, Yaakobo omwaana wa Arifayo, Tadayo,
Simooni Omuzeroote
na Yuuda Isikariyoti, wuno yamuriiri omukoonyo Yeesu.
Ambe, Yeesu akaragania abhaanabheega ikumi na bhabhiri bhayo, akabhuga, “Mutagya kubhaatu bhano bhatari Abhiiziraeri, na mutasikira mumugye gwogwoosi gwa Samaria.
Nawe mugeende ku Bhiiziraeri, bhayo ni kye eziingʼoondu zino zibhuriri.
Hano mukugya owaabhu, mubhe murarwaaza kubha, ‘Obhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro bhuri haguhi!’
Muhorye abharweeri, muryoore abhaku, muhorye bhe ebhigeenge na muheebhe amasaambwa amabhi. Mubhweeni obhunagya bhuyo bhusa, na neemwe bhoono muruusye obhusakirya bhweenyu bhusa.
Mutagega mubhiguzi bhyeenyu eziizahaabu, naabhe eziimbirya, naabhe eziishaba.
Naabhe mutagega esakwa, naabhe emyeenda ebhiri, kasi ebhikweera, kasi ehiimbo. Omuhokya wuyo woosi areenderwa ahaabhwe amariho gaaye.
“Omugye gwogwoosi guno muraasikire, mukomye omuutu wuno araabhaginihye mumugye gwaaye. Mwiikare owaaye tee eriibhaga rino muraatanure hayo.
Hano muraasikire munyuumba muyo, mubhakeerye abhaatu bhaaye, ‘Omureembe gubhe neemwe.’
Ambe, eraabhe bhariho abhaatu bhano bhano omureembe, okukeerya kweenyu kurabhaha omureembe, nawe eraabhe bhatana omureembe guyo, omureembe gubhakyoorere emwe.
Hano muraahike munyuumba yoyoosi kasi omugye gwogwoosi, na abhaatu bhaamu bhatakubhaginihya kasi bhatakubhiitegeerera, mutanure hagiro hayo mwiikungʼuute oruteeri kumaguru geenyu.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, kurusiku rwo okutina ekiina, Taatabhugya arabhatema emwe bhukongʼu kukira abhaatu abhabhi bha Sodoma na Gomora.
Eziinyaako zino zikuuza
“Mwiitegeerere, ndabhatumania kye eziingʼoondu gatigati ye eziisuuzi. Kweego, mubhe na amangʼeeni kye enzoka, kweeki mubhe bhanyoohu kye ebhiguuti.
Mwiiriihe na abhaatu, kwo okubha bharabhahira mwiibaraza bhabhaseme, kweeki bharabhatema emijariti muziinyuumba zyaabhu zye eziisaango.

Bharabhahira embere wa abhaanaangwa na abhatemi kwe ekigirirye muniikiriirye. Mureenderwa kubha abhamenyeekererya bhaane bha Amangʼana Amazomu, embere yaabhu ne embere ya abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi.
Hano bharaabhagwaate, mutabha no obhwiitiimaati kubha muragaambaki kasi muragaambabhwi, kwo okubha kwe eriibhaga riyo, Taatabhugya arabhaha amangʼana go okugaamba.
Etari kubha emwe muragaamba, nawe ni Koro wa Taatabhugya Wuuso weenyu wuno akugaamba kuhitira kweemwe.

“Kwe eriibhaga riyo, omuhiiri aramutuura omuhiiri waaye mumabhoko ga abhabhisa okubha yiitwe. Kweeki, taata aramutuura omwaana mumabhoko ga abhabhisa okubha yiitwe. Abhaana nabho bharabharwaania abhiibhuri bhaabhu no okugirya bhiitwe.
Abhaatu bhoosi bharabhabhiihirirya kwe ekigirye kyo okubha emwe ni bhaanabheega bhaane. Nawe, wowoosi wuno araagumire tee obhuteero, niwe araatuuribhwe.
Eraabhe murakorerwa obhubhi mumugye omurebhe, muryaarire mumugye oguundi. Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, mutakumara emirimo gyeenyu mumigye gyoosi gya Iziraeri, enye Omwaana wo Omuutu nikyaari kuuza.
“Omwaanamweega atakunagya kumukira omweegya waaye, no omugya atakumukira omukuru waaye.
Omwaanamweega areenderwa abhe kyo omweegya waaye, no omugya neewe abhe kyo omukuru waaye. Enye ni mukuru weenyu na bharanibhirikira Beerizeburi.
Eraabhe bhanibhirikiiri ego, mbe, emwe bhatakubhabhirikira amariina mabhiihu kukiraho?
Taatabhugya niwe wo okwoobhohwa
“Ambe, mutoobhoha abhaatu bhayo. Kyokyoosi kino kikuundikiirwe, kirakuundukurwa neemwe, kweeki kyokyoosi kino kibhisirwe, kirarorekana.
Goosi gano nikubhabhuurira mukiirima, mugagaambe mubhweero. Kweeki, goosi gano mukwiigwa kwe embiso, mugarwaaze kubhweero.
Mutoobhoha bhano bhakwiita omubhiri, nawe bhatakunagya okwiita eziikoro. Emwe mumwoobhohe Taatabhugya omweene ego, ewe niwe akunagya kusikya omubhiri hamwe ne ekoro mumuriro gwa nyaari.
“Angu, ebhitorookobhwe bhibhiri bhitakuguribhwa kwo obhuguri bhusuuhu? Naabhe, kitariho ekinyonyi kimwe kino kikukwa eraabhe Wuuso weenyu wa mwiisaaro atiikiriirye.
Na neemwe, Taatabhugya amenyiri obhubhari bhwe eziinzweeri zyoosi zye emitwe gyeenyu.
Kweego, mutoobhoha, kwo okubha emwe muno obhuguri bhukuru kukira ebhitorookobhwe bhyaaru.
“Omuutu wowoosi wuno akugaamba embere ya abhaatu kubha aniikiriirye enye, enye Omwaana wo Omuutu woosi ndamwiikirirya embere wa Taata waane wa mwiisaaro.
Nawe, wowoosi wuno akunianga embere ya abhaatu, na neenye ndamwaanga embere ya Taata waane wa mwiisaaro.
Yeesu ni kigirye kya abhaatu okutwaanikana
“Mutiiseega kubha niiziri mukyaaro kino kwiiguru yo okureeta omureembe. Nitiiziri kwiiguru yo omureembe, nawe kwiiguru yo okureeta obhutwaanikani.
Niiziri okureeta obhutwaanikani gati yo omumura na wiise waabhu, omuukya na nina, na gati yo omukamwaana ni inyibhyaara.
Abhabhisa bho omuutu bharabha abhaatu bha munyuumba yaaye.

Omuutu wowoosi wuno akuseega wiise waabhu kasi nina waabhu kukira enye, wuyo atakuningʼarira kubha omwaanamweega waane. Kweeki, wowoosi wuno akuseega omumura waaye kasi omuukya waaye kukira enye, wuyo woosi atakuningʼarira kubha omwaanamweega waane.
Omuutu wuno atakweenda okugega omusaraba gwaaye
no okunituniirira, wuyo atakuningʼarira kubha omwaanamweega waane.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akweenda kuriibha obhwiikari bhwaaye omweene, arabhubhurya. Nawe omuutu wowoosi wuno araabhurye obhwiikari bhwaaye kwiiguru waane, wuyo niwe araabhubhone.
Esaambo ya abhaatu bhano bharaasuungʼaaneabheega bha Yeesu
“Omuutu wowoosi wuno akubhaginihya emwe, aniginihirye enye. Kweeki, wowoosi wuno aniginihirye enye, amuginihirye na Taatabhugya wuno anitumiri enye.

Wowoosi wuno akumuginihya omurooti kwo okubha ni murooti, Taatabhugya aramuha esaambo kya yo omurooti. Kweeki, wowoosi wuno akumuginihya omuutu waane we eheene kwo okubha ni muheene, Taatabhugya aramuha neewe esaambo kya we eheene.
Wowoosi wuno akumuha naabhe ekikoombe kya amaanzi amameezu owumwe wa abhaatu bhano kwo okubha ni mwaanamweega waane, eheene Taatabhugya atakweebha okumuha esaambo yaaye.”

footnotes.text: Simooni Omuzeroote yaari na amariina abhiri. Erimwe ni Simooni Omuzeroote, eriindi ni Simooni Omukananaayo. Amariina gano bhakamubhirikira omuutu wuno yaari yiiteeni eriihi ryo obhuheene okurwa mubhukaangati bhwe Ekirooma. Rora Mariko 3:18; Ruuka 6:15.
Mwiikungʼuute oruteeri kumaguru geenyu, obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha, Taatabhugya yaangiiri abhaatu bho omugye guyo, kwo okubha bhaangiri abheega bhaaye.
Beerizeburi ni riina eriindi rya Seetaani, omukuru wa amasaambwa amabhi goosi.
Okugega omusaraba gwaaye, obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha, okwiikirirya enyaako yoyoosi yirya kasi naabhe okukwa kutuukana no okumutuniirira Yeesu.
